hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A buy/sell hook that deducts a 4% fee on each swap: ETH fees from buys accumulate in a burn pot for periodic buyback-and-burn swaps via the pool, while token fees from sells are queued for direct burn. Pool initialization and liquidity addition are each one-time gated per token; exact-output swaps always revert. Additionally, sell swaps can be gated by an admin-controlled allowlist (via timeBased/hasValue): any address can activate this sell restriction for a token by calling pitchWC(), after which only addresses allowlisted by the deployer can complete sells, and only the deployer can deactivate the restriction.
